copy.tagline: 审查 Dart 代码风格并优化结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在写 Dart 代码并希望遵循最佳风格。
copy.tagline_en: Review Dart code style and improve structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write Dart code and want to follow best practices.

howto.what: Claude 在编写或审查 Dart 代码时，会按照 Effective Dart 指南检查命名、类型、样式、导入、文档等，并提供符合规范的代码建议和修正。
howto.when: 当你编写 Dart 代码、审查样式、重构命名、添加文档注释、结构化导入或强制执行类型注解时触发。

say.text: 检查这段 Dart 代码的命名是否规范。
say.note: 它会逐一检查并给出建议。

say.text: 帮我重构这个 Dart 文件的导入语句。
say.note: 它会优化导入结构并遵循相对路径规则。

say.text: 给这个类添加文档注释。
say.note: 它会生成符合 Effective Dart 风格的文档。

howto.what_en: Claude will check naming, types, style, imports, documentation, and more against Effective Dart guidelines when writing or reviewing Dart code, providing compliant suggestions and fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you write Dart code, review style, refactor naming, add doc comments, structure imports, or enforce type annotations.

say_en.text: Check naming conventions for this Dart code.
say_en.note: It will examine each identifier and suggest corrections.

say_en.text: Refactor imports in this Dart file.
say_en.note: It will optimize import paths and ordering.

say_en.text: Add a doc comment to this class.
say_en.note: It will generate a compliant summary comment.
